reading.notes: particle_size_d50: paper gives D50≈72μm only for real lunar-surface regolith (Apollo/Carrier 2003 comparison, p.13), not for this product; not a measured Lumina90 value. particle_size_mean_um: the only stated 'average particle size' (2.4 mm, µCT) is for Lumina2000 only (3D shape analysis was carried out only on the Lumina2000 sample). density_g_cm3 (particle/grain density): Section 2.5 (p.3) describes the pycnometer method (NS-EN ISO 17892-3:2015) used to measure solid-particle density ρs, but no numeric result for any product appears in the main text, tables or figures — likely reported only in Supplementary Material, which is not included in this PDF. specific_gravity, cohesion, friction_angle, angle_of_repose, ph, glass_content_percent: none of these terms/values appear anywhere in the paper (checked with full-text search); 'volcanic glass' is listed only qualitatively as a trace AMICS mineral phase, with no glass content percentage given. Oxide values and most Mineralogic-method mineral wt% values (anorthite, andesine, anorthoclase, clinozoisite, and the unquantified trace list) are stated in running text only as joint ranges for 'the Lumina samples' collectively (no per-product breakdown, and no formal in-text bulk-chemistry or mineralogy table — the actual per-product tables are Supplementary Tables S4–S9, which are not present in this PDF); per the task's joint-value rule they are reported identically under all three products. Only the Mineralogic-method quartz wt% (3.1/5.3/1.0 wt%) and the AMICS-method modal percentages are resolved per specific product name. Bulk-density Table 2's single column merges two distinct quantities under one header ('Min-max dry unit weight' / 'Loose tapped bulk density (g/cm3)'); order of the two numbers on the second line was inferred to be (loose, tapped) based on internal consistency (loose < tapped in every row) and the header word order 'Loose tapped'.
